newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Polysindo to produce 340,000 tonnes PTA.
newsitem.headline: Polysindo to produce 340,000 tonnes PTA.

text.p: Indonesian integrated polyester maker PT Polysindo Eka Perkasa plans to produce 340,000 tonnes of purified terephthalic acid (PTA) annually from February, a senior company official said on Monday.

Corporate secretary Bakttavatsalam confirmed Monday's media reports quoting Polysindo president Marimutu Sinivasan as saying the company would no longer need to buy PTA, a main chemical ingredient for polyester chip.
Currently, the firm has to buy PTA from Bakrie's chemical plant and Pertamina, media reports quoted Sinivasan as saying.
Polysindo's PTA production capacity would account for about one-third of Indonesia's total PTA output capacity, he said.
Conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers currently produces 500,000 tonnes of PTA annually, reports said.

Sinivasan said local demand for PTA was projected to increase by 15 percent to 20 percent annually over the next five years, making a production capacity expansion at his PTA plant commercially viable in the near future.
The PTA plant was part of the firm's $575 million PTA, polymer and staple fiber expansion programme, Sinivasan said.
